event_text: A group calling itself n0n claims to have JPMorgan Chase customer data and posts similar claims about Visa and Mastercard
notes: Date only. The group's claim as reported by Reuters and BleepingComputer; not confirmed.

event_text: JPMorgan Chase says vendors that provide it services were the target of a cyberattack
notes: ABC News says the company made its statement on Thursday morning.

event_text: Reuters reports statements from JPMorgan Chase, Visa and Mastercard about attacks on their vendors
notes: Publication time of the copy on Business Insurance; Mastercard's statement is dated Thursday by ABC News.
